tagline: Slugs n' Bugs — a tilt-glide slug, a glowing slime trail, letter-bugs to eat, words to spell, salt to fear
jam: Humboldt Game Jam, theme 'Slugs n' Bugs', solo entrant (Aaron), web HTML5, disclosure of AI-assisted build on the itch page
engine: Godot 4.7 GDScript, PORTRAIT 540x960, stretch canvas_items/expand, gl_compatibility, web-first

laws.growing_battery: each milestone adds suites; done = 2x consecutive green
laws.injectable_input: COPY scripts/tilt_source.gd from gyro-squadron-45 (jam-legal pre-existing code), touch-drag default on web
laws.original_assets: Flux sprites + procedural SFX (owned, in-house generated)

core_loop: glide the slug; leave a persistent glowing slime trail (Line2D ribbon, fades over ~6s); bugs scatter when you get close — chase and eat them; each bug carries a letter; the round shows a TARGET WORD — eating its letters in order fills it; complete the word = big score x multiplier + new word; salt crystals kill on touch; endless escalating spawns

spelling.word_source: data/word_list.txt common tier (copy SCOWL common from arcade)

milestones: 1 SLUG CORE: glide + slime trail + wandering bugs + eating (the juice)
3 salt + escalation + run loop + HUD + SFX
